exposure: lack of information on the mode of delivery during ANC
cohort: The study included 355 pregnant women with one previous scar arriving for delivery at Iringa Referral Hospital.
finding: Significant predictors of emergency second caesarean section included lack of employment, late booking, category of healthcare provider, lack of information on mode of delivery during ANC, third-trimester ultrasound scanning, and pregnancy interval.
mod_finding: The study identified several factors, such as lack of employment and late booking, as significant predictors for emergency second caesarean sections.
cross-section timing: Data was collected serially from women at the point of delivery over a six-month period.
